turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey there, how have things been?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ah, it's been a long day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A few friends invited me on a long weekend ride.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fun! They're doing either the flat forty mile loop or the hilly twenty five mile one. Which do you think your legs can handle?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I have to take this call. Hang on and stay quiet until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hello, yes, I'm expecting a parcel.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You're at the wrong entrance, it's the side gate.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you see the green door?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Perfect, just leave it on the step.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Done with the call. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hope the call went okay. You were picking the weekend ride, flat and long or short and hilly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The flat one. Hills and I are not friends.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair. Bring two water bottles and a snack for the halfway point.
